items.title: Implement shared signed workspace resolver and story_resolve surface
items.context: Add a shared resolver that separates metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, authoritativeCwd, worktreePath, resolutionSource, and unresolvedReason. story_resolve must not present a non-git wrapper root as executable REVIEW cwd when signed workspace is unresolved.
items.userSees: User sees story_resolve JSON include metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, authoritativeCwd, resolved, resolutionSource, and unresolvedReason; non-git wrapper roots no longer appear as executable REVIEW cwd.

happy.desc: story_resolve for an ordinary git-backed REVIEW story reports resolved=true and a signedWorkspaceRoot rooted in the git worktree.

edge.desc: story_resolve for a non-git metadataRoot with no worktree/gitRoot reports resolved=false, signedWorkspaceRoot=null, authoritativeCwd=null, and an unresolvedReason instead of returning the wrapper root as executable cwd.

adversarial.desc: story_resolve does not auto-select a nested git repository merely because one exists below metadataRoot.

items.title: Bind review_run_start and REVIEW evidence consumers to resolved signed workspace
items.context: Use the resolver for review_run_start snapshot capture and scope binding, preserve metadata writes through metadataRoot, fail closed for unresolved wrapper-root cases, and add/preserve signed workspaceBinding/process-fact consistency as needed.
items.userSees: User sees review_run_start sign the resolved signedWorkspaceRoot, persist workspaceBinding on reviewer runs, and reject pass/finding evidence whose binding or material facts are stale or mismatched.

happy.desc: review_run_start for a resolved signed workspace starts a run and persists workspaceBinding fields consistent with top-level headHash/materialHash.

edge.desc: review_pass_set/finding_add freshness behavior still rejects stale reviewer runs after material changes using the same signed workspace facts.

adversarial.desc: Tampered or mismatched workspaceBinding on a review run is rejected before pass/finding evidence can be accepted.

items.title: Add regression coverage for split-root and Authority-boundary cases
items.context: Cover normal git roots, non-git wrapper roots, explicit gitRoot, linked worktrees, no HEAD/materialHash, stale or tampered workspace binding, and Authority overclaim prevention without requiring a real Authority Server.
items.userSees: User sees regression coverage prove split-root behavior: git-backed roots work, wrapper roots fail closed unless explicitly bound, placeholders/tampering remain rejected, and local reviewer evidence is never reported as Authority proof.

happy.desc: Regression smoke covers ordinary git root and explicit gitRoot split-root cases where story_resolve resolves and review_run_start can capture HEAD/materialHash.

edge.desc: Regression smoke covers non-git wrapper root without gitRoot/worktree and verifies story_resolve/review_run_start fail closed with clear unresolvedReason/not_git_repo diagnostics.

adversarial.desc: Regression coverage proves placeholder hashes, tampered workspaceBinding, and local-only reviewer evidence cannot be treated as Authority Server completion or receipt-backed proof.

items.title: Implement explicit gitRoot signed workspace binding path
items.context: Add a concrete operator repair path for wrapper-root projects by supporting an explicit gitRoot configuration that resolves metadataRoot/gitRoot as the signedWorkspaceRoot after validating it is a git repository with HEAD/materialHash. This closes the ClawCreek issue beyond diagnostics while avoiding arbitrary nested repo guessing.
items.userSees: User can repair wrapper-root projects by setting an explicit gitRoot; Lattice validates that gitRoot is a real git repository and uses it as signedWorkspaceRoot without guessing nested repositories.

happy.desc: A non-git metadataRoot with config gitRoot pointing to a real git repository resolves signedWorkspaceRoot to that gitRoot and review_run_start captures HEAD/materialHash there.

edge.desc: An explicit gitRoot that is missing, outside the project contract, or not a git repository fails closed with a clear unresolvedReason and does not create a review run.

adversarial.desc: When metadataRoot contains multiple nested git repositories, Lattice only uses the explicit gitRoot/worktree binding and never chooses one by directory scan.
